title: DNS zone record hygiene
description: Identifies dangling DNS records pointing to deleted Azure resources, which could be hijacked by attackers.
example_prompt: "Query all Azure DNS zones and Private DNS zones. For each A, AAAA, and CNAME record, verify the target resource still exists in the subscription. Flag records where: (1) target IP is not assigned to any resource, (2) CNAME target domain is not resolving, (3) alias records referencing deleted resources."
